decisions.choice: Use the existing mobile UraiQ welcome composition as the post-sign-in handoff, with Continue entering Chats.
Make the signed-in experience chat-first: Continue and fallback routes open Chats, with soft white mobile surfaces, rounded 1:1 conversation cards, purple message actions, and a lifted bottom dock.

Replace the old dark desktop/social shell with a centered mobile phone frame on wide screens, force stored dark theme back to the light reference palette, redirect legacy Home/Reels routes into Chats, and add a purple UraiQ Direct inbox card.
decisions.source: user feedback after seeing old UI

decisions.choice: Make the mobile shell function like a real 1:1 chat app: bottom tabs route to real Chats, Calls, New, Find, and You screens; New uses the live user search/create-chat API; Calls and Find are backed by the live conversation list rather than social mock sections.
decisions.source: user request for fully functional realtime UI with proper alignment
